description: This is a unit test class for the FormatWithNull class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests that the getFormattedValue method always returns null regardless of input.

classes.name: FormatWithNullTest
classes.description: A test case class for testing the behavior of the FormatWithNull formatter.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of FormatWithNull before each test.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Verifies that getFormattedValue returns null for various inputs: integer, string, and DateTime object.
